name: smh_xs_ring_kmr_1019

RTL change 81d8cf4b9 (ot_hbm_accel_smh.sv: OT_SMH_XSE E-face control copy as its own kept register; verified by CLOSED_STANDS); the kit also puts o_iw/o_ix on the N face (closed LEF had them on N/W/S/E), so native_spread (same faces) does not apply. Then hf5bt (smh_xs_ref_p45m-hf5bt-e1b14e06f) fixed the spread (gate 68.9/59.4) but ended NEEDS_RTL FF -45.75 on CTS-tree -> boundary-tree zero-logic hops (hold ECO rc=9).
reroute_reason.fix: regional km20 clock roots in place of the bnd_branch single tree; macro-local posedge ring read/write address captures; own ring reset relay. 0 added data/startup edges.

layer_cap_grant: coordinator el1012 (as smh_xs_ref_p40x): the closed xs p50/p45 @0fbf9bc20 recipe (region-grouped pins, M6 routing) with horizontal face pins on M4 ONLY: the closed views carry 362 M4 + 318 M6 face pins, and ASAP7 M4 (y 12/48) and M6 (y 16/64) tracks have no common mirror residue (MX needs y0+H = 8 mod 16 for M4 and 0 mod 16 for M6), so the SM tile cluster's leaf-1 MX/R180 xs cannot sit on track; M6 stays a routing layer only
structural_change: LH-SMATT/XS variant A after rg2 terminal clock FAIL (boundary 149.5/136.4 ps, one root 20,550 sinks 16 stages, Codex bnd_branch leaves up to 316 loads; TT reg->ring read-address -80 ps): (1) the custom bnd_branch tree is dropped; 20 regional clock roots by 2-D k-means on placed sinks (clock_split_km.tcl, equal-count clusters ~1,030 sinks, so the 9.8k south-centre mass gets ~10 roots beside it) under a CTS-balanced top tree; (2) every ring macro gets KEPT macro-local posedge read AND write address captures (OT_SMH_RING_LOCAL_ADDR/WADDR: full-cycle launch beside the macro, no shared negedge address flops); (3) the ring counter/captures take their own kept reset relay (OT_SMH_RING_RST2) so the leaf relay stays <= 32 loads. Same 8 macros, outline, faces and 0 added data edges.

pin_regs.reason: Existing RTL input and output pin registers retained; explicit OT_SMH_XSRST two-stage face reset landing. Zero added data edges.

reset_landing.reason: OT_SMH_XSRST lands raw rst_a in two plain posedge RTL registers before any reset relay. The hxh flow flag alone did not insert the landing with pin_regs disabled.

hold_budget_reason: Preserve registered RTL port contract and existing input hold cells; explicit reset landing in RTL. New SRAM ring plus geometry changes, no flow-added pin stages.
